decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core cheese range that remained visible beyond launch, this semi-hard cheese wheel fits the stable, narrow organic portfolio the company is likely to preserve.

Although flavored cheese variants are somewhat riskier given earlier portfolio pruning, this spicy cheese line had its own page and broadens the established cheese offer enough to justify keeping it unless sales disappoint.

This mild creamy soft cheese matches the firm's organic, quality-focused positioning and appears to be a natural complement to the existing assortment, so it is more likely to stay than to be withdrawn.
